::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** May 29 1868  
**Manuscript:** Copy outletter book British Library Add MSS.55387 (1) P. 400
:::

My dear Miss Yonge,
[I](people/person_939.qmd) send you the first copy of the [Cameos](cmy_books/cmybook_73.qmd) which has been bound. It has been delayed about that title page, in which I wanted to produce a [cameo effect](organizations/other_167.qmd), [*illegible*] that may be. The book I am sure is a charming book and we tried to give it an adequate dress.

I think [Clay](organizations/other_173.qmd) is making better progress with the [Selections](cmy_books/cmybook_71.qmd). [Miss Sewell](people/person_1301.qmd) seems satisfied. I have never I think spoken of terms to you or her. We would I think be disposed to buy this as we did the Cameos. Do you think this would please both? One cannot [*4 lines too pale to read*.] 

I dont forget that we owe you for the Cameos & the [Pupils](cmy_books/cmybook_72.qmd). I am afraid that we shall find the <u>number published</u> of the [Library](organizations/other_145.qmd) [*illegible*] of the volumes.

Yours very faithfully
Alex Macmillan
